name: therapy_benchmarking_questions
description: A dataset of therapy-style prompts and expected responses intended to measure a model's ability to produce safe, empathetic, and clinically appropriate replies. It focuses on conversational therapeutic scenarios, crisis-awareness, and adherence to basic counseling principles. The benchmark is used to evaluate response quality, safety, and alignment with therapeutic norms.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but growing use in research on safety, mental-health aligned responses, and therapeutic dialogue evaluation.
